create_globals_instance: create an _InternalGlobals instance to manage ONNX exporter configuration state
configure_training_mode: configure the training_mode property on _InternalGlobals to set EVAL or TRAIN mode for export
set_export_onnx_opset_version: set the export_onnx_opset_version property on _InternalGlobals to a valid ONNX opset version
check_in_onnx_export: check the in_onnx_export boolean property to determine if ONNX export is currently in progress
toggle_autograd_inlining: toggle the autograd_inlining property on _InternalGlobals to enable or disable autograd inlining during export
